== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[LE-BO2D9 (Leebo) (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1240_68</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 70), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-70-LE_BO2D9_Leebo.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-lebo2d9leebo-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[LE-BO2D9 (Leebo) (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May be battled. If with Dash Rendar, adds one destiny to attrition only. Once per turn, if at a battleground, you may peek at the top card of opponent's Reserve Deck; may place that card on top of opponent's Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_68</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, slip number 70, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
